content.label:
I first downloaded this app about 6 years ago and used it with a friend. We both loved it; it was a simple way to keep us both off our phones and on task. Each of us even bought a subscription. 

These past few months, the UI updates and AI integration have made this app so, so clunky. It breaks my heart to say that it's an eyesore now. The designs feel so much less simple and human-made. Clicking through a series of prompts makes the planting feature less efficient to use. 

Please, please offer some settings to help us go back to the way things were. Cut the AI garbage and cumbersome UI. For an app that espouses the value of getting off screen and going out into the world to do good (planting trees irl, getting your work done and be a functioning person), the AI integration is such a big disappointment. 

I've been actively searching for better apps to use. Please Forest, listen to those of us posting here and online.
Too much interactive animation and required presses post session and annoying ,can’t be turned off , it used to be faster and much smoother than this “improved version”

If you’re someone who loves to game-ify the mundane, this app should be right up your alley. I didn’t think this would be my holy grail study tool, but that’s what it’s become. Being able to look back and see all the progress I’ve made studying for my Associates and now my Bachelors is so reaffirming and inspiring. I really love the newer “stopwatch” feature, as instead of having the pressure of meeting a certain time, I’m able to just go with the incentive that if I hit that 2-hour make, the tree will surely come into full bloom. I’d recommend this app to anyone who wants a gentle nudge away from their phone for any reason, and I’m seriously considering upgrading to Premium because I just love the app, and they have an incredible mission behind them (which is what drew me in to begin with)!

Stop monetizing everything. Stop pushing the subscription onto everyone. I already paid you, I’m not giving you more. And a lot of users are probably students who should be pressured into paying for features that should be free. Trend analysis as tags aren’t exactly special features that should be behind a paywall. 

It’s so obvious that you only care for the people who pay the subscription. Everything good goes to them. They get bonus daily tasks for gems. They get new trees. I have thousands of coins and absolutely nothing to spend them on because you’re only focusing on things for your subscription. And that’s after the shop got “fixed.” Which it didn’t, not really. You got rid of bundles, which I was saving for since they were a little discounted. You have to hope you’re lucky and get a gem tree that you want when you finally saved enough. We wanted more trees, not whatever this is. 

Just stop. You’ve pushed so many people away from your app because you keep ruining it. You made it take so long just to get to the Home Screen after a session. My app glitched on me today and the alert that the session stopped and rewards came an hour after I stopped it. You made an entire event on a feature that so many people couldn’t find at first since finding it isn’t intuitive. 

Please, for the love of God, stop making this app worse. Stop asking for money when people have already paid.

title.label: Please Bring Back Swiping the Circle and Tree Preview

content.label: The app used to let you easily swipe around the circle to select a time and preview what the tree would look like. Now that feature is gone, and I can’t see what the tree will look like before planting it. This is extremely frustrating. Please bring back the old time-selection and tree-preview feature.

title.label: Thank you for fixing my biggest complaints

content.label: The Ui is a bit more simplified, the backgrounds are beautiful, we now have more tree options rolling through (three would NOT have been enough but the refresh fixed that issue and incentivizes me to check daily), the land masses are finally part of the store instead of being weirdly tucked in settings. Good job, team! Wish we’d had a cute fall themed event, but I’m sure cleaning up this mess took up all their time lol
Update version sucks

I used to value the app a lot, but the recent changes have made it much worse.  Now whenever I’ve finished a period, the screen requires me to tap it to “ claim my reward” and then click two more screens before allowing me to go back to focus. They’ve removed icons from the screen so I can no longer tap to see the forest I’ve grown.  And rather than a dial around the tree icon allowing one to adjust the focus time, there’s a separate ruler beneath that makes seeing and adjusting times much more difficult.  I’d like to go back to the old version, and if I can’t I’ll look for other productivity apps.

I love the new designs of trees being added, but everything about setting a focus timer and ending it is now bogged down by transition animations that are completely unnecessary.  It shouldn’t take me ten extra seconds to end the previous timer and start a new one. Just setting a timer has an added step of opening a menu to do it instead of prior iterations where it was built into the screen itself. I’m finding I don’t want to use it anymore which is sad because I’ve been here for years and years.

The app used to be easy to use but now is really cumbersome. It takes longer to plant a tree and multiple clicks to plant another. I really miss the the little clock like interface where you could select
Time and see how the tree would grow with more time. Now you have to select a tree then go to the slider. The slider is cumbersome and you can’t see what your tree will look like after a certain amount of time.  At least if they 
Brought back that as an option the muscle memory I’ve developed by planting so many trees over the years could be of use again.  While some of the changes are ok it’s like they forgot their core purpose.
This new interface is so ugly and hard to use it takes five thousand years to get back to the home page please bring back the old UI there’s way too much going on rn

I’ve been using Forest daily since 2019 or so, and I was a paid user from day one. I even bought some crystals at the start. The new subscription model adds so much unnecessary bloat, on top of the repeated UI changes and constant glitching. It feels like designs, design decisions, code, and customer service emails have all been delegated to AI. Imagine the irony of what used to be a tree planting app turning to AI to make its assets and decisions! If the devs don’t turn things around by the end of the year, I’m deleting this app and moving on to an app with devs who don’t rely on AI to run their business. Why are they charging a monthly subscription for a worse app?

Like others point out the app used to be great but now they’re pushing their subscription service and you have to click through multiple stupid dialog to start another session which happens frequently when you use it to work daily. Revert back to the last years edition and you’ll have happy customers again. They clearly did this to try and make money it’s shameful

Very frustrating. Completely ok for newer users but I paid for the app over two years ago. We should be grandfathered in. Please if I’m wrong tell me where to adjust the timer in the app but I couldn’t find it now and it was easy to find just a month ago. Extremely frustrating

Before everything you needed was in one view, but now you have to click on so many different buttons just to change a single thing. The new update might look more modern, but the usability has went down a lot.

Something happened, and now all of the trees I purchased, land styles, and coins are gone!   Where did they go?

Edit:  I logged out and logged back in. Most of my stuff is back.

title.label: Bad update: A focus app shouldn’t become a distraction

content.label:
I’m a Forest fan, but the latest update has made the app frustrating to use. After each focus session, I have to tap through too many confirmations and reward screens just to collect coins and move on. The extra steps and animations add friction to something that used to feel simple.

A productivity app should respect our time and attention. I use Forest to stay focused, and these unnecessary interactions have become another distraction.

Please make rewards automatic and fast. A 0.1s quick button tap and then it should be done.  Bring back the simple, efficient experience that made Forest so enjoyable.

title.label: Been using since 2016, dislike new update

content.label: For the last month or so, once a tree has completed growing, I have to click 4 times and wait until I can plant another tree. Because of this friction, I am using the app less and focusing less. I enjoyed the previous version where I could quickly start another focus session.

I love this app!! Even though I don’t use it as often as I should to get work done… I can never find an app that is MORE SATISFYING then this one… the new updates are even better

I sent in a suggestion and guess what!! They listened!!

I’m really disappointed with the changes made to the app. I really miss the old designs of the trees and plants in particular! The classic tree and the simple visual changes for increases in time were so much better than the new design. Not everything needs to be upgraded or changed. If something isn’t broken, don’t fix it. What was wrong with the old design? 

Also why am I being marketed Plus if I already have Pro? It feels like the app I used to love was killed and now it’s an evil zombie back from the dead trying to extract money from me, pretending to be an old friend. Part of the reason I supported this app in the first place was because it allowed for a one time payment rather than a subscription model. Now I feel like the rug has been pulled out from under me. I don’t even have access to what I thought I paid for because the app interface, look, and feel has changed so much. 

I already paid for this app and now they’re taking features away and gate keeping them with a subscription. I see the replies in the comments acting like pro is still valid but, cmon bro, you know what you did. You cheapened it to try to get more money from me. Shameless.
I paid for this app when it used to be not free, then they updated it with a subscription and I no longer have access to features that i already PAID for.
Please bring back the old interface, this new UI is terrible. You have to click 3 times to get back to the home, and you can’t see the different tree stage while setting the time.

new ui is so ugly

title.label: Love Forest, but the new UI broke the repeat flow

content.label: I’ve used Forest for a long time, and it used to be wonderfully simple. After the recent major UI update, finishing a tree has become frustrating: I now have to tap through multiple steps just to claim the coins. Worse, the old flow let me quickly repeat/restart a new tree with the same duration from the lock screen after finishing one. That no longer works, because I have to unlock my phone, open the app, claim the reward through several taps, and only then start again. This breaks the quick focus loop that made Forest so effective. Please bring back one-tap repeat from the lock screen and make claiming rewards much faster.

deleted immediately when I found out I'd have to pay to listen to a podcast while in focus mode

Pros: Amazing app! It helps to keep off my phone while studying, and even when I turn off the "deep focus" feature, I can still use the app to track how long I've been studying each subject. I love that the more I study, I can save up reward coins to buys lots of different plants to my forest! It allows you to label your focus sessions, and track how much time you spend on different topics too, which is really nice. 

Cons: I paid for a Pro membership previously, but it has now been "downgraded" since they added the Plus membership. I just wish the previous Pro members would've been automatically converted to Plus members or would've been able to get Plus membership benefits under the previous Pro Membership. 

Either way, amazing app, highly recommend!

title.label: New UI Has Some Pros, But I Haaaaate the Popups

content.label:
They changed the user interface today. 

What I like:
- The new “my plants” section makes it easier to see trees.
- It’s easier to pick a tag.

What I don’t like:
- Annoying popups flash across my screen when I finish planting a tree and want to back to the home screen! This app is supposed to reduce distractions, not create them. 
- Some of the trees displayed are not purchasable in the store, yet clicking on them still takes me to the store. 
- There are still very few tag colors. Other people and I specifically submitted a feedback request asking for more tag colors, but there are still just a handful. 

What I feel mixed about:
- The trees bounce up and down, and the coin icon shimmers. It’s kind of cool, but also very distracting.



Edit; I changed my review to one star. They’re now deleting trees from the regular store and making you rebuy them for a much higher price only on certain days when they happen to appear in the temporary store that refreshes daily. This is so stupid. It’s clear that they’re creating a scarcity mindset to pressure people to check the app often. That goes against the whole point of making an app to get you off your phone!
I deleted the app because all of a sudden it needed to know everything about me. I just wanted a cute pomodoro app. 😢
